items.question: In the UAE, do users need to subscribe manually to receive SMS alerts for social protection services?
items.gold: No, SMS alerts for social protection services are automatically available to users who apply for or use entity services.
items.fact: Social protection SMS alerts are automatic, no manual subscription needed.

items.question: In the UAE, how do users of social protection services get SMS alerts and mobile notifications?
items.gold: They are automatically available to all users who apply for or use entity services.
items.fact: Social protection alerts are automatic for users of entity services.
